character.name: Webster
character.description: A friendly, round-bodied cartoon spider with big cute expressive eyes and eight small legs, dangling naturally from a single silvery strand of silk that it spun from above, the way a real spider hangs from its own web thread.

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
